title: Section-normalized characteristic pullback under a strict log morphism
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a strict morphism of fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] and assume the log structure of $X$ is Zariski [lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup]. There is a natural section map $\overline M_X\to f_*\overline M_Y$ on their actual sharp Zariski sheaves. For every pair of opens $W\subset X$, $V\subset f^{-1}W$, every relative scheme map $k:V\to W$ over $f$, and every log section $s$ over $W$, restriction of its image to $V$ is the sharp class of the actual log section $f(s)$ computed using $k$. The resulting monoidal-space map has underlying map $f$ and bijective stalk maps at every point of $Y$. No fan chart is part of this assertion.

source.place: ILO VI 1.1--1.2; VIII 3.3.12 and proof of Theorem 3.3.15, printed p.109, strict characteristic map before the point-local comparison.

proof.text: Apply the first clause of lem-trf-strict-log-blowup-cartesian to f and the Zariski log structure of X. It supplies the actual sharp-space map c, equality of its base with f, its normalization on every log-section germ and bijectivity of its stalk maps. Transport its section natural transformation along the equality of bases.

Fix W,V,k,s as in the statement. At each y in V apply the supplied germ normalization for this very relative log section. Naturality of the actual germ construction identifies the left germ with the germ of the restriction of the transported section map. Thus the two sections on V have equal germs at all its points. Sheaf separation makes them equal, also on the empty open. Transport along an equality of base maps preserves the stated stalk bijections.

theorem strict_sharp_space_sections
    {Y X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}} (f : EtaleLogHom Y X)
    (hf : f.IsStrict) (hX : X.logStructure.IsZariski) :
    ∃ sections : X.logStructure.sharpSpace.presheaf ⟶
        (Opens.map f.base.base).op ⋙ Y.logStructure.sharpSpace.presheaf,
      (∀ (W : X.scheme.Opens) (V : Y.scheme.Opens)
        (k : V.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme) (hk : k ≫ W.ι = V.ι ≫ f.base)
        (h : V ≤ f.base ⁻¹ᵁ W)
        (s : X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op ((logOpenEtale X.scheme).obj W))),
        Y.logStructure.sharpSpace.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
            (sections.app (op W) (X.logStructure.sharpSection W s)) =
          Y.logStructure.sharpSection V
            (f.sectionMap ((logOpenEtale X.scheme).obj W)
              ((logOpenEtale Y.scheme).obj V) k hk s)) ∧
      ∀ y : Y.scheme, Function.Bijective (FineFan.stalkMap
        (InducedCategory.homMk { base := f.base.base, c := sections } :
          Y.logStructure.sharpSpace ⟶ X.logStructure.sharpSpace) y)
